description: payments-svc 'Add risk scoring for large charges' fails only charges >= 1000 (the Headphones): a fraction of orders fail.

deploys.author: aisha
deploys.message: Add risk scoring for large charges
deploys.diff:
--- a/payments-svc/charge.py
+++ b/payments-svc/charge.py
@@ -44,6 +44,10 @@ def charge(body: Charge):
+    if amount >= 1000:
+        score = amount / 1000
+        if score > 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"risk score out of range: {score:.3f}")

ground_truth.trap: only some orders fail, so the error rate is modest and looks like noise
